title: Destruction Decoded
description:
S01 E06 — Man Made Disasters
As technology advances, manmade accidents have become as destructive as some natural disasters; a look at recent catastrophes.

title: Strangest Things
description:
The Macabre Hat of Teeth
A museum in South London contains a disturbing tattered hat made of brown felt and decorated with more than 80 human teeth; using the latest imaging technology, experts investigate to uncover the macabre origins of this mysterious Victorian-era cap.

title: Strangest Things
description:
The Mamari Tablet
An ancient tablet discovered on the remote reaches of Easter Island is etched in a mysterious glyph system that has yet to be deciphered; experts use cutting-edge tech to determine if this wooden relic could be the key to a lost civilization.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E05 — Curse of the White Dwarf
White dwarfs are small, dead stars with a dangerous side, and they are capable of exploding into supernovas and destroying planets; new research suggests these mysterious phenomena may be the key to understanding the universe itself.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E07 — The Next Supernova
The galaxy is full of stars ready to explode into supernovas, a stellar detonation powerful enough to destroy all life on Earth; it's an event that hasn't occurred in 400 years, and the search is on to locate which star may be next.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S08 E07 — Edge of the Universe
We don't yet know where the edge of the universe is or what happens there; but thanks to cutting-edge technology and new discoveries, experts might finally reveal the secrets of the phenomena.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E01 — Terror of Nazi Propaganda
After seizing power in 1933, Adolf Hitler began systematically transforming a peaceful German population into a ruthless war machine; experts investigate the innovative methods used by the Nazis to indoctrinate and control the will of its citizens.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E03 — Mary Magdalene Enigma
Mary Magdalene played a pivotal role in early Christianity and witnessed the execution and resurrection of Jesus Christ; experts investigate the truth behind her mysterious disappearance and embark on a quest to locate her undiscovered remains.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E04 — Secrets of Gobekli Tepe
The ancient site of Göbekli Tepe is the oldest building complex ever discovered and continues to baffle archaeologists; experts investigate new theories behind its construction as a possible commemoration to a cataclysmic event.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E06 — Secrets of the Crucifixion
Uncover the true stories surrounding great treasures, long-held conspiracy theories, ancient relics and lost civilizations as experts analyze and investigate history's most astonishing mysteries.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E07 — MK-Ultra Revealed
The CIA's MK-Ultra program sought to create mind control methods through unethical human experimentation, and now, experts investigate classified documents that reveal the horrific atrocities that were carried out in the pursuit of national security.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E02 — The Devil's Bible
"The Codex Gigas," also known as the "Devil's Bible," is a giant medieval tome that has evoked fear for centuries and is believed to contain a malevolent power; experts investigate its legendary secrets and uncover the mystery behind its author.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E05 — Mystery of the Hypogeum
A subterranean Neolithic temple discovered on the island of Malta contains the skeletal remains of thousands of humans; experts use forensic archaeology to investigate elongated skulls that may unlock the secrets of an advanced, lost civilization.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S12 E03 — Indiana's War Factory
Satellite images capture a large compound of abandoned structures that are overgrown with vegetation in Indiana; experts investigate and uncover a derelict WWII munitions factory that played a crucial role in US military history.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S12 E04 — Turkey's Lost Terror Dome
Aerial drone imaging captures a circular man-made structure that appears to be centuries-old in the remote forests of Aydin, Turkey; experts investigate a lost ancient amphitheater with a history steeped in gladiatorial bloodshed.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S12 E05 — Blood Feud of Gresham Castle
Satellite images capture a mysterious fortification concealed beneath a patch of woodland in the remote stretches of Norfolk, England; experts investigate rival royal families and a lost castle that was destroyed during a medieval blood feud.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S12 E06 — The Boneyard of Arizona
Satellite images capture miles of aircraft precisely arranged in the vast Arizona desert; experts investigate the largest aircraft storage facility on Earth and the rotting remains of a defining moment in Cold War history.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S12 E07 — Nevada's Mystery Marking
Satellite images capture an enormous X shape mysteriously carved with precision in the remote Nevada desert; experts investigate a military emergency landing field linked to one of the most astonishing test programs in aviation history.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S12 E08 — Ghost Ship of Ireland
A ghost ship appears overnight on the shores of Ireland; it may help shed light on the fate of vessels claimed by the most notorious patch of ocean on earth.

Kari, Tory and Grant put their lives on the line as they test a classic tale from the farmyard; we've all heard it, if you have to cross a field with a bull, the last thing you want to do is wear red.

Kari, Tory and Grant put a radio-frequency identification conspiracy theory to the test; Adam and Jamie test two myths about weapons.

title: Mission Unexplained

title: Mission Unexplained
description:

A Russian soldier describes being lured into a swamp by an unnatural entity; an Ohio military base with a UFO connection; an interview with a US Air Force colonel whose alien-craft sightings are finally confirmed.

title: Secrets in the Ice
description:
S02 E04 — Mystery of Mummy Cabin
Archaeologists discover an unusual man-made rock formation in the remote Altai Mountains of Russia, and conducting a further excavation, they unearth an ancient log cabin and the mummified remains of two bodies buried deep in the frozen permafrost.

title: Secrets in the Ice
description:
S02 E05 — Mystery of Glacier Mummy
Mountain climbers in California find the body of a U.S. Army soldier; strange bundles of canvas and wood are discovered on an Alaskan mountain; volcanic glass is found in an unexpected place; a vital World War II weather station is uncovered.

title: Secrets in the Ice
description:
S02 E10 — The Ancient Oland Massacre
Archaeologists discover human remains during an excavation of a fifth-century fort on the Swedish island of Öland; after further investigation, experts unearth 26 skeletons and uncover the site of an ancient massacre.

title: Secrets in the Ice
description:
S02 E08 — Buried Secrets of Mount Cook
Climbers make a shocking discovery when they encounter the remains of two human bodies high atop New Zealand's Mount Cook; after a forensic investigation, a decades-old mystery reignites that could rewrite mountaineering history.

title: Secrets in the Ice
description:
S02 E03 — Secrets of the Ice Arsenal
An unidentified metal object is found on Kiska Island; a centuries-old gold mining mystery is investigated; in Siberia, a network of ice tunnels is explored; fossils unearthed in the Canadian Arctic lead to the discovery of a new species.

title: Secrets in the Ice
description:
S02 E06 — Siberia's Frozen Necropolis
Archaeologists make a grim discovery when they uncover the remains of a mummified boy buried in the frozen Siberian landscape, and as researchers continue their excavation, they uncover 88 additional graves linked to a mysterious, ancient necropolis.

title: Secrets in the Ice
description:
S02 E09 — Riddle of Whale Bone Alley
A new theory about the sinking of the Titanic emerges; a treeless circle in the middle of the woods is probed; a formation of giant whale bones is discovered sticking out of the ground; researchers study the loudest sound ever recorded underwater.

title: Lost Beasts of the Ice Age
description: Top scientists from around the world look to uncover extraordinary evidence relating to the lives of Ice Age animals, including the fabled woolly mammoth.

title: Unearthed
description:
S08 E04 — Ghosts of Venice
Venice was once a fearsome superpower home to secrets, wealth, and treachery; today, scientists use pioneering acoustic imaging technology to discover the city's ancient foundations and reveal how it's still standing.

title: Unearthed
description:
S10 E12 — Olous: Lost City of the Ancients
The lost city of Olous: A great metropolis submerged in the Mediterranean; archaeologists uncover its secrets using pioneering technology and CGI reconstruction.

title: Unearthed
description:
S08 E01 — Mystery of the Volcano Temple
The Pantheon is a 2,000-year-old temple with a secret; using cutting-edge archaeological methods and brand-new evidence, experts look beneath the streets of Rome to find out why it was built and how it survived so long.

title: Unearthed
description:
S08 E02 — Rome's Gate to Hell
According to legend, the ancient Roman city of Hierapolis hides a secret portal to the underworld beneath its streets; armed with pioneering technology, archaeologists gain rare access to investigate the deadly truth behind these hellish myths.

title: Unearthed
description:
S08 E06 — Secrets of Seahenge
A prehistoric mega-structure emerges from the sands of an English shore that could reveal lost mysteries of the Bronze Age; using pioneering technology and 3D imaging analysis, experts uncover dark, ancient rituals once performed here.

title: Unearthed
description:
S08 E03 — Legend of King Midas
King Midas and his legendary golden touch is one of the most famous tales in Greek mythology; using advanced archaeological methods, experts travel deep inside mysterious ancient mounds to investigate the truth behind the myth.

title: Assassination in the Valley of the Kings
description: For the first time in over 100 years, archaeologists have exclusive access inside the Valley of the Kings to excavate Pharaoh Ramses III's 3,000-year-old burial chamber.

title: Cleopatra: Mysteries at the Museum
description: Don Wildman travels to Alexandria, Egypt, in search of the lost tomb of Cleopatra, where he hopes to discover the true legacy of one of history's most mysterious and iconic female leaders.

S08 E04 — Death of the Last Stars
The universe's stars are dying off faster than new ones are born; using the latest technology, experts investigate the secrets of the last stars of the cosmos and what this stellar apocalypse means for life on Earth.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S08 E08 — Monsters of the Milky Way
The center of the Milky Way is home to strange and deadly phenomena that is difficult to understand; with the help of science, experts reveal how the black hole, the galaxy's core, shapes life on Earth.

title: UFOs: The Lost Evidence
description:
S02 E04 — UFO Tech
An exploration into whether breakthroughs such as high-energy lasers, antigravity technology and super-advanced aircraft are the result of human efforts alone or contact with UFOs.

title: UFOs: The Lost Evidence
description:
S02 E01 — Nazi UFO Secrets
Evidence reveals the development of secret Nazi weapons not long after an alleged UFO crashed in Germany's Black Forest; UFO experts investigate whether the U.S. government co-opted this technology for its own space and military programs.

title: Phantom Signals
description:
S01 E06 — To Catch a UFO
When a U.S. Air Force intercept aircraft chases after a UFO, it vanishes forever without a trace; a new investigation tries to uncover what caused this mysterious disappearance.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E07 — Subterranean Silo Survival
A decommissioned missile launch facility in Kansas remained one of the best kept subterranean military secrets of the Cold War; experts reveal how this abandoned underground complex transformed into a state-of-the-art survival bunker.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E09 — Ireland's Underground Alcatraz
Subterranean military fortresses situated on the southern coast of Ireland have protected against enemy invasion for over 400 years, and now, experts investigate how this powerful stronghold transformed into a brutal and terrifying prison.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E02 — Cincinnati's Secret Caverns
Deep beneath the streets of Cincinnati lies a network of deserted tunnels and caverns that contain a remarkable history of the city's origins, and now, experts investigate to reveal who built this underground labyrinth and why it was abandoned.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E10 — Medieval Maze of Secrets
A forgotten world of ancient underground passages and medieval engineering lies hidden beneath the town of Exeter, England; experts investigate and reveal how this ambitious tunnel system was the result of one of the deadliest epidemics in history.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E08 — Italy's Subterranean Secret
An unprecedented landslide unveils a hidden world beneath a picturesque town in northern Italy, and now experts investigate this vast network of tunnels and passageways that stretch 300 feet underground to reveal the city's subterranean past.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E06 — Buried Lab of the Black Hills
Buried nearly a mile beneath the Black Hills of South Dakota is a cutting-edge laboratory at the forefront of astonishing scientific research; experts reveal advancements engineers achieved more than a century ago that keep it operating today.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E01 — Hotel Bunker of the Apocalypse
The top-secret construction of a massive nuclear bunker remained concealed under a palatial West Virginia hotel for decades; experts reveal how this vast subterranean structure was one of the most closely guarded Cold War secrets in U.S. history.
